card.name: Linking words before insect repellent or sunscreen
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, use, like, and, contain) right before an expected mention of insect repellent (DEET) or sunscreen/protective products. Appears in advice about bite avoidance and sun protection.

modes.label: Before DEET or repellent
modes.description: Linking word just before DEET or insect repellent is named.
modes.example: products that contain DEET (N,N-diethyl-m-toluamide), a common component<< of>> insect repellent products.

modes.label: Before sunscreen advice
modes.description: Verb or 'and' in advice to wear protective clothing and use sunscreen.
modes.example: Advise patients to wear protective clothing and<< use>> broad-spectrum UVA/UVB

card.writes: It pushes the model toward DEET and bug-related words, and away from paint-related words.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before the text names bug repellent like DEET or sunscreen.
